title: User manual
hero: Free · Ad-free · No account · Works offline

sec.m2:
Reading

Tap a surah and start reading. The top toolbar:

Aa · ReadingOpens the Latin transliteration.
ScriptScript, mushaf, text size, line spacing.
Line by lineLays the verses out line by line.
BookmarkMarks your current place.
TestMemorization test mode.

Tip: Pinch with two fingers to make the text larger or smaller.
sec.m3:
Script & mushaf

Three scripts

Osman TahaThe script of the calligrapher of the Medina mushaf.
Elifa Mushaf NesihAiry, easy on the eyes.
NesihFor small screens.

Two mushafs

The same Qur’an, different orthography:

MedinaTurkish
“upon”عَلَىٰعَلٰى
“was sent down”أُنزِلَاُنْزِلَ
Lafẓ al-Jalālaٱللَّهُاللّٰهُ

Which one? If you are used to the mushaf printed in Turkey, choose Turkish; if you are used to the mushaf seen on Hajj/Umrah, choose Medina. Both are correct — the text is verified letter by letter against Tanzil (the Medina standard).
sec.m4:
Pause marks

The small letters shown in rose in the text are reading instructions — not letters of the Qur’an.

ۘMîm — you must stop.
ۙLâ — do not stop, continue.
ۚCîm — stop or continue, as you wish.
ۖSalî — continuing is preferable.
ۗKalî — stopping is preferable.
ۛThree dots — stop at one of the two.
ۜSîn — saktah: a brief pause, do not breathe.
۟ ۬This letter is written but not recited.
۩Prostration verse.
sec.m5:
Listening

As the reciter reads, the word being read is highlighted.

Repeat (5×)How many times the same verse repeats. Perfect for memorizing.
Speed (1.0×)0.7× slow, 1.5× fast.
Combine (1+2)Listen to consecutive verses together.

Memorizing recipe: Repeat 7×, speed 0.8×, combine 1+2. Listen to a verse seven times slowly, then combine two.
sec.m6:
Word selection

  1. Long-press a word — wait half a second, the phone vibrates gently.
  2. Drag your finger — the words you pass over get selected.
  3. Lift — a strip appears on top: “Verse 2 · 3 words”.

After selecting: Listen (plays only those words) · Mark · Add note · Memorized.

Selecting the three words you get stuck on — not the whole long verse — and replaying them is the most effective memorization technique.
sec.m7:
Test mode

  1. Tap Test at the top — the words turn into grey boxes.
  2. Recite from memory. Verse numbers and the word “Allah” stay visible.
  3. Tap a word you get stuck on — only that one is revealed.
  4. When done, tap Show and check yourself.

In test mode, long-press does not work — tapping means show/hide.
sec.m8:
Memorization

Select a verse → Memorized. The app tells you when to revise. After each successful revision the interval grows:

1st revisionafter 1 day
2nd revisionafter 3 days
3rd revisionafter 1 week
4th revisionafter 2 weeks
5th revisionafter 1 month

If you get stuck, the interval resets. You see harder verses more often.

Sabak = new memorization · Sabkî = revision of recent days · Manzil = general revision of what was memorized long ago. This is the classical method of ḥifẓ.
sec.m11:
Offline

The app opens in airplane mode.

Qur’an text (two mushafs)No internet needed
Three scripts (font)Not needed — embedded
Reading, memorizing, test, notesNot needed
Recitation (audio)Needed — or download in advance
TogetherNeeded — shared data on the server

Use Settings → Offline downloads to download the audio and listen without internet.
sec.m12:
FAQ

Is the text accurate?
It is verified letter by letter against Tanzil (the Medina standard). 114 surahs, 6236 verses, each surah’s verse count exactly matching the standard Ḥafṣ count.

Is it paid? Are there ads?
No. Free, ad-free, no account.

Where is my data?
Your notes, bookmarks and memorization record are only on your phone. Nothing is sent anywhere. Only the Together data is on the server — and that consists of just a name and a juz number.

Why does the reciter stop?
The audio comes from the internet. Download it in advance via Settings → Offline downloads.
sec.m9:
Juz’ sharing

Share the 30 juz’ with one link. No account, no one has to install the app.

First understand: there are TWO DIFFERENT LINKS

LinkFor whomWhat it does
JOIN
?k=abc123		Send to the group.Pick a juz’, mark as read.
ADMIN
?y=x9k2m…		You keep it.Correct, download report.

Do not send the admin link to the group. Anyone who has it can change or delete juz’.

Example from start to finish

1Hüseyin: Together → Start khatm. Intention: “Healing for my mother”. Name: Hüseyin. Create.
2The app generates two links. He taps Share on WhatsApp → the join link drops into the group.
3Ayşe: Taps the link. The 30-juz’ table opens. She taps an empty cell, writes her name. Juz’ 1 is now Ayşe’s.
4Mehmet: Taps the same link. He sees juz’ 1 is taken (Ayşe’s). He takes the free juz’ 5.
5Ayşe reads: When done she taps Read ✓. The cell turns green. Everyone sees it instantly.
6Hüseyin: Opens with the admin link. 23% — 7/30 juz’ read. Who took, who read — all visible.
7Reminder: A ready WhatsApp message listing the missing juz’ goes to the group.
8Finished: At 30/30 a celebration appears. A PDF report downloads — with the readers’ names.

Juz’ colours

GreyEmpty — tap, take it.
YellowTaken — someone has it, not read yet.
GreenRead.
RedOverdue — the deadline passed.

Common situations

“I took a juz’ but won’t be able to read it”
Long-press your juz’ → Release. It becomes free again. A juz’ marked read cannot be released.

“I marked read by mistake”
Only the admin can correct this.

“Does everyone have to install the app?”
No. Tapping the link opens it in the browser. No account, no sign-up, no install.
sec.m10:
Group dhikr

A shared goal: 1000 salawāt, 313 Āyat al-Kursī… Everyone reads their share, the goal fills up together.

Example from start to finish

1Hüseyin: Together → Start intention. Taps Salawāt — the goal auto-fills to 1000. Intention: “For the ummah”. Create.
2Sends the join link to the group.
3Ayşe: Taps the link. A tasbīh ring appears. For each salawāt she taps the crescent in the middle — the beads fill up.
4Sends her share: read 133 → “Add my share to the goal (133)”. The shared goal becomes 133/1000.
5Mehmet 100, Fatma 90… The ring begins to fill.
663% — 633/1000. Below, “Those praying (6)” — names are visible, but not who read how much.
7When the goal is reached: a celebration. A report image is sent to the group.

Intention sincere, the count hidden. Who read how much is visible to no one — neither participants nor the admin. Only the total and the names appear. This is deliberate: to close the door to showing off. Not a race — unity.

Don’t forget to send your share. Tapping the ring is not enough. Until you press “Add my share to the goal”, your count stays only on your phone.

backup.title: Backup and restore
backup.hero1: All your effort is on this phone.
backup.hero2: Your memorization record, notes, bookmarks and ḥifẓ progress are all on your device. If you lose the phone or delete the app, they won’t come back.
backup.warn: The app sends nothing to a server — that’s our privacy promise. The cost: you must take your own backup. Once a month is enough.
backup.s1_p: A single file downloads. Send it to yourself on WhatsApp, upload it to Drive, email it — keep it wherever you like, it’s yours.
backup.tip: Easiest way: press the button → WhatsApp → pick your own number. The backup stays in your chat forever. On a new phone, just open WhatsApp and tap the file.
backup.btn_export: Or download the file to your phone
backup.s2_p: On the new phone, install the app and choose your backup file here. Everything comes back.
backup.danger: Warning: restoring overwrites your existing records. No problem on a new phone; on your old phone you could lose today’s progress.
backup.table_tip: The file is plain text; you can open and read it. It has no passwords or personal info — only your records.
backup.no_backup: You haven’t taken any backup yet.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.hero2: Free · Ad-free · No account · Anonymous usage stats
privacy.tip: In short: The app does not collect personal data (name, email, precise location). No ads. To improve the app we collect anonymous usage statistics (Firebase / Google Analytics) — not linked to your identity. The only data linked to you is the name you enter of your own choice in the Together feature.

sec.g1:
1 · Data

Elifa Mushaf does not collect:

  1. Name, email, phone number (except in Together — see below)
  2. Precise location (GPS)
  3. Contacts, photos, files
  4. Your notes, bookmarks and memorization records (these stay on your device)
  5. Advertising ID or any data for advertising
Anonymous usage statistics. To improve the app we collect anonymous data via Firebase / Google Analytics: app opens, session duration, which screens and features are used, language and theme choice, approximate region (country, from IP), device type, and an anonymous analytics identifier. This data is not linked to your identity, contains no personal information and is never sold. Daily statistics records are auto-deleted after 90 days.
sec.g2:
2 · Data that stays on your device

The following is stored only on your device. Nothing is sent to any server:

DataWhere it lives
Your bookmarksThe device’s local storage
Your notesThe device’s local storage
Your colour marksThe device’s local storage
Memorization record and revision scheduleThe device’s local storage
Where you left offThe device’s local storage
Theme, script, mushaf preferencesThe device’s local storage
Downloaded recitation audioThe device’s local storage (IndexedDB)

If you delete the app, this data is deleted too. We keep no copy.
sec.g3:
3 · The “Together” feature — the only exception

If you use khatm/juz’ sharing and group dhikr, the following data is stored on our server:

DataWhy
The name you enterSo the group can see who took which juz’. You can enter any name — a pseudonym works too.
The juz’ number you took and its statusTo show the khatm’s progress.
Your dhikr countTo add to the shared goal. Who read how much is shown to no one — only the total appears.
Organization title (intention)So participants know what it is being read for.

Not collected: email, phone, IP-linked profile, device ID. No account, no registration, no password.

Where stored: On Netlify infrastructure (Netlify Blobs). Servers are located in the United States and Europe.

How long: Until you delete the organization. For deletion, write to the address below.
sec.g4:
4 · Recitation audio

Audio files are fetched from third-party servers (quranicaudio.com, everyayah.com). While playing, these servers see your device’s IP address — as with any file download on the internet. We do not collect or store this information.

You can pre-download the audio via Settings → Offline downloads and use it fully offline.
sec.g5:
5 · Children

The app is suitable for all ages. We do not knowingly collect data from children — we do not collect personal data from anyone anyway.
sec.g6:
6 · Data sharing

We do not sell, rent or share any data for advertising. We do not pass anything to third parties except where legally required.
sec.g7:
7 · Your rights

  1. Deletion: If you want to delete an organization you created in Together, write to us — we’ll delete it.
  2. Access: The only datum we hold about you is the name you entered in Together.
  3. Device data: Deleting the app is enough; it all goes.
sec.g8:
8 · Changes and contact

If this policy changes, it is updated here and the date is changed. If there is an important change, it is announced in the app.

For questions, deletion requests or concerns:
Email: info@elifaplatform.com
Web: elifaplatform.com
